mapper.select: select id, title, content, difficulty, tag, time_limit, memory_limit, template_code, accepted_count, submit_count, solution_count, status, create_time, update_time from problem where id = #{id}
select tag from problem where status = 1
mapper.insert: insert into problem(title, content, difficulty, tag, time_limit, memory_limit, template_code, status) values(#{title}, #{content}, #{difficulty}, #{tag}, #{timeLimit}, #{memoryLimit}, #{templateCode}, #{status})
mapper.update:
update problem
title = #{title},
content = #{content},
difficulty = #{difficulty},
tag = #{tag},
time_limit = #{timeLimit},
memory_limit = #{memoryLimit},
template_code = #{templateCode},
status = #{status},
update_time = NOW()
where id = #{problemId}
update problem set submit_count = submit_count + 1 where id = #{problemId}
update problem set accepted_count = accepted_count + 1 where id = #{problemId}
